seo_gallery_title: Rigged 3D Model Gallery: Real Results | AutoRig
seo_gallery_description: Browse real 3D models rigged and animated by AutoRig V3: characters, animals, hands and cars. Newest first, filter by rig type, open any in the viewer.
gallery_page_subtitle: Real public tasks rigged by AutoRig V3: characters, animals, hands and cars. Newest first; open one to watch it move in the viewer.
gallery_empty: No rigged models of this type yet. Try another rig type.
gallery_about_p1: Every card is a real public task. AutoRig V3 rigged it from one upload, retargeted the animation clips and checked the result in the background of the viewer. Hover a card to preview the animation; open it to watch the model move in the Unity viewer.
gallery_about_p2: Results are sorted by date, newest first, and the rig type filter narrows the list to one preset. Every task is one viewer with an agent chat, and you can download GLB, FBX, USDZ, a ZIP, a Unity package or a Blender file.
gallery_about_p3: Want the same for your model? Drop it on the home page; the target is a rigged, animated model within one minute from pickup.
